cs.t: I use two or three high CRI (95+) yuji LED bulbs that are 3500K (warm daylight) and around 1100lmns. These are in lamps as side lighting facing away from me (so that the light shines on the walls). In the mornings I also have some bright down lighting that is a bit cooler - probably around 5000K, the light from these is noticeable at the top of my vision to help me wake up and become alert. For non-work lighting I have Philips Hue bulbs everywhere and are very happy with those. But for very high CRI these bulbs are excellent:  https://www.yujiintl.com/high-cri-led-lighting.html
